summarize_LVIS_CATEGORIES: summarize the LVIS_CATEGORIES list of 1203 object detection category dicts with id, name, frequency, synset, synonyms, and def fields
create_function_lookup_category: create a function that looks up an LVIS category by its integer id and returns the name, frequency, and synonyms
build_dataset_category_index: build a dict mapping LVIS category ids to category names for use in detectron2 dataset registration
test_LVIS_CATEGORIES_integrity: test that LVIS_CATEGORIES contains exactly 1203 entries with unique ids from 1 to 1203 and no None values
review_LVIS_CATEGORIES_format: review the LVIS_CATEGORIES data structure for detectron2 compatibility including frequency codes f, c, r and synset fields
